title: Founder NFT
lead: A free, non-transferable NFT for every person verified with Human Passport. One per person, one per address.
connectHint: Connect a wallet to get or manage your Founder NFT.
hpOnly: The Founder NFT is available only to people verified with Human Passport.
disabled: The Founder NFT is not available right now. Please try again later.
done: Done. Your Founder NFT is up to date.
yourNftHint: It is soulbound: it cannot be sold or transferred.
rebindTitle: Move your Founder NFT to this wallet
rebindLead: Your Human Passport already owns Founder NFT {{n}} at {{holder}}. You can move the same number to this wallet. The old token is burned after a 72-hour waiting period.
dedupTitle: This wallet cannot be verified again
dedupLead: These Human Passport stamps were already used by another wallet, so this account cannot reach verification. You can move Founder NFT {{n}} from {{holder}} to this wallet. The old token is burned after a 72-hour waiting period.
rebindPendingTitle: Your move to this wallet is pending
rebindPendingWait: Waiting period: {{time}} left. The current holder can cancel until then.
rebindReady: The waiting period is over. Complete the move now.
holderPendingTitle: A move of your Founder NFT is pending
holderPendingBody: A request was made to move Founder NFT {{n}} to {{holder}}. It completes in {{time}}. If this was not you, cancel it now.
holderPendingReady: The waiting period for the move to {{holder}} is over, so it can no longer be cancelled.
mintedElsewhere: This Human Passport already owns a Founder NFT at another address. Link your Human Passport wallet in the verification step above to move it here.
mintClosed: The Founder NFT mint window has closed.
errRejected: You declined the request in your wallet.
errNotConfigured: The Founder NFT is not available right now. Please try again later.
errNotEligible: Only people verified with Human Passport can get a Founder NFT.
errAlreadyHolder: You or this Human Passport already have a Founder NFT.
errMintClosed: The Founder NFT mint window has closed.
errExpired: The authorization expired. Please try again.
errSignatureStale: The authorization is no longer valid. Refresh the page and try again.
errNotHolder: Only the current holder of the Founder NFT can do this.
errDelayActive: The 72-hour waiting period is not over yet.
errNoPending: There is no pending move, or it can no longer be changed.
errConflict: Your Human Passport matches more than one person. Please contact support.
errUnavailable: The network or Human Passport is not responding. Please try again.
errGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errWalletAuth: Confirm this wallet and try again. The confirmation was missing, expired, or signed by a different address.
